explanations.text: Rowan confirms that the workshop is still on Saturday.
The revised start time is spoken as ten thirty, half an hour later than the leaflet time.
Rowan directs participants to the side entrance beside the bicycle shelter and says the main doors will remain locked.
Rowan says the class moved because electricians need the main hall that morning.
For arrivals after ten forty, Rowan says to ring the workshops bell so reception can let the participant in.
Rowan says the centre needs to confirm the updated arrangements were received and asks for a reply only if the participant cannot attend.
